Now let me write more scenario tests covering advance, audit, edit, prepare/commit/cancel, replays, and conflicts. Let me build a realistic scenario.

Let me set up a simple graph: n=3, links: (0,1) cap 10, (1,2) cap 10. Participants {0,2} with demands. 

Test scenarios:
1. Load with bookings; audit; advance; expiry.
2. Edit: blocked, forced, safe.
3. Prepare: replay, conflict, stale, REFERENCE, TIME, WINDOW; prepared and denied.
4. Commit: MISSING, OWNER, replay, GONE, DENIED, stale, success.
5. Cancel: stale, MISSING, OWNER, success, repeated.

Let me write these.

For a prepare that succeeds: n=3, links (0,1) cap 10, (1,2) cap 10, participants 0 and 2 with r=1 each, period 1, envelope [[0,1],[1,1]] → c = 1 per link. Cut condition: S={0}: cut = link0 (c=1) ≥ r_0=1 ✓; S={2}: 1 ≥ 1 ✓; S={0,1}: cut = link1 = 1 ≥ 1 ✓; S={1,2}: link0 = 1 ≥ 0... wait r(S∩C) for S={1,2} = r_2 = 1 → cut = link0 (between 0 and 1) = 1 ≥ 1 ✓. So feasible ✓ → prepared.

Then commit with rev 0 → ok, rev 1.

Let me write these tests.

cd /workspace && cat > tmp/svc_test2.py << 'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from svc_test import run, check, fails, fresh

LOAD = '{"op":"load","n":3,"links":[[0,1,10],[1,2,10]],"bookings":[]}'
def P(pid='j1', owner='o', s=0, e=4, per=1, parts=((0,1),(2,1)), env=((0,1),(1,1)), rev=0):
    return {"op":"prepare","id":pid,"owner":owner,"window":[s,e],"period":per,
            "participants":[list(x) for x in parts],"envelope":[list(x) for x in env],"rev":rev}

# --- audit / advance -----------------------------------------------------
h = run('audit0', [LOAD,'{"op":"audit","at":[0,5,5]}'],
        [{'status':'ok','rev':0,'now':0},
         {'status':'ok','rev':0,'now':0,'leases':[],'samples':[[0,[10,10]],[5,[10,10]],[5,[10,10]]]}])
run('audit_neg', [LOAD,'{"op":"audit","at":[0,-1]}'], [None,{'status':'invalid'}])
run('audit_big', [LOAD,'{"op":"audit","at":[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8]}'], [None,{'status':'invalid'}])
h = run('adv', [LOAD,'{"op":"advance","time":5}','{"op":"advance","time":5}','{"op":"advance","time":4}','{"op":"audit","at":[4]}'],
        [{'status':'ok','rev':0,'now':0},{'status':'ok','rev':1,'now':5,'expired':[]},
         {'status':'ok','rev':2,'now':5,'expired':[]},{'status':'error','code':'TIME','rev':2},
         {'status':'error','code':'TIME','rev':2}])

# --- bookings expire -----------------------------------------------------
LB = json.loads('{"op":"load","n":3,"links":[[0,1,10],[1,2,10]],"bookings":[{"id":"b1","owner":"o","window":[2,5],"envelope":[[0,4]]},{"id":"b2","owner":"o","window":[0,3],"envelope":[[1,7]]}]}')
h = run('expire', [LB,'{"op":"audit","at":[0]}','{"op":"advance","time":3}','{"op":"audit","at":[3]}','{"op":"advance","time":5}','{"op":"audit","at":[5]}'],
        [{'status':'ok','rev':0,'now':0},
         {'status':'ok','rev':0,'now':0,'leases':['b1','b2'],'samples':[[0,[10,3]]]]},
         None,
         {'status':'ok','rev':1,'now':3,'expired':['b2']},
         {'status':'ok','rev':1,'now':3,'leases':['b1'],'samples':[[3,[6,10]]]]},
         {'status':'ok','rev':2,'now':5,'expired':['b1']},
         {'status':'ok','rev':2,'now':5,'leases':[],'samples':[[5,[10,10]]]]}])
# cancel an expired lease -> MISSING ; commit expired -> GONE
run('dead', [LB,'{"op":"advance","time":5}','{"op":"cancel","id":"b1","owner":"o","rev":1}','{"op":"commit","id":"b1","owner":"o","rev":1}','{"op":"commit","id":"b1","owner":"x","rev":1}'],
    [None,None,{'status':'error','code':'MISSING','rev':2},{'status':'error','code':'GONE','rev':2},{'status':'error','code':'OWNER','rev':2}])

# --- edit ----------------------------------------------------------------
h = run('edit_stale', [LOAD,'{"op":"edit","rev":1,"changes":[],"force":false}'],
        [None,{'status':'stale','rev':0}])
h = run('edit_ref', [LOAD,'{"op":"edit","rev":0,"changes":[[2,5]],"force":false}'],
        [None,{'status':'error','code':'REFERENCE','rev':0}])
h = run('edit_noop', [LOAD,'{"op":"edit","rev":0,"changes":[],"force":false}','{"op":"audit","at":[0]}'],
        [None,{'status':'ok','rev':1,'cancelled':[]},
         {'status':'ok','rev':1,'now':0,'leases':[],'samples':[[0,[10,10]]]}])
h = run('edit_down_ok', [LOAD,'{"op":"edit","rev":0,"changes":[[0,5]],"force":false}','{"op":"audit","at":[0]}'],
        [None,{'status':'ok','rev':1,'cancelled':[]},
         {'status':'ok','rev':1,'now':0,'leases':[],'samples':[[0,[5,10]]]}])
# blocked edit because a live lease uses it
h = run('edit_blocked', [LB,'{"op":"edit","rev":0,"changes":[[1,3]],"force":false}','{"op":"audit","at":[0]}'],
        [None,{'status':'blocked','rev':0,'link':1,'time':0,'used':7,'capacity':3},
         {'status':'ok','rev':0,'now':0,'leases':['b1','b2'],'samples':[[0,[10,3]]]}])
# blocked edit in the future (lease starts later)
h = run('edit_blocked_future', [LB,'{"op":"advance","time":3}','{"op":"edit","rev":1,"changes":[[0,3]],"force":false}'],
        [None,{'status':'ok','rev':1,'now':3,'expired':['b2']},
         {'status':'blocked','rev':1,'link':0,'time':3,'used':4,'capacity':3}])
# force revokes
h = run('edit_force', [LB,'{"op":"edit","rev":0,"changes":[[1,3]],"force":true}','{"op":"audit","at":[0]}'],
        [None,{'status':'ok','rev':1,'cancelled':['b2']},
         {'status':'ok','rev':1,'now':0,'leases':['b1'],'samples':[[0,[10,7]]]}])
# force with an increase does not revoke
h = run('edit_force_up', [LB,'{"op":"edit","rev":0,"changes":[[1,20]],"force":true}','{"op":"audit","at":[0]}'],
        [None,{'status':'ok','rev':1,'cancelled':[]},
         {'status':'ok','rev':1,'now':0,'leases':['b1','b2'],'samples':[[0,[10,13]]]}])
# force equal capacity does not revoke
h = run('edit_force_eq', [LB,'{"op":"edit","rev":0,"changes":[[1,7]],"force":true}'],
        [None,{'status':'ok','rev':1,'cancelled':[]}])

# --- prepare -------------------------------------------------------------
h = run('prep_ok', [LOAD, P()],
        [{'status':'ok','rev':0,'now':0}, None])
res = h(P())
check('prep_replay', res, {'status':'replay','id':'j1','rev':0,'base_rev':0,'outcome':'prepared'})
res = h(P(owner='z'))
check('prep_conflict', res, {'status':'error','code':'CONFLICT','rev':0})
res = h(P(parts=((2,1),(0,1)), env=((1,1),(0,1))))
check('prep_replay_reordered', res, {'status':'replay','id':'j1','rev':0,'base_rev':0,'outcome':'prepared'})
res = h(P(rev=1))
check('prep_conflict_rev', res, {'status':'error','code':'CONFLICT','rev':0})
# stale / reference / time / window priorities
run('prep_stale', [LOAD, P(rev=3, parts=((0,1),(9,1)), s=99, e=100, per=7)], [None,{'status':'stale','rev':0}])
run('prep_ref', [LOAD, P(parts=((0,1),(9,1)))], [None,{'status':'error','code':'REFERENCE','rev':0}])
run('prep_ref_link', [LOAD, P(env=((0,1),(5,1)))], [None,{'status':'error','code':'REFERENCE','rev':0}])
h = run('prep_time', [LOAD,'{"op":"advance","time":2}', P(s=1,e=4)],
        [None,None,{'status':'error','code':'TIME','rev':1}])
run('prep_window', [LOAD, P(s=0,e=5,per=2)], [None,{'status':'error','code':'WINDOW','rev':0}])
run('prep_window_ok', [LOAD, P(s=0,e=4,per=2)], [None,None])
# failures are not recorded -> can retry with a different payload
h = run('prep_retry', [LOAD, P(rev=9), P()], [None,{'status':'stale','rev':0},None])
res = h(P())
check('prep_retry2', res['status'], 'replay')
# too many participants / duplicates / zero demand
run('prep_dup_part', [LOAD, P(parts=((0,1),(0,2)))], [None,{'status':'invalid'}])
run('prep_zero_demand', [LOAD, P(parts=((0,0),(2,0)))], [None,{'status':'invalid'}])
run('prep_one_part', [LOAD, P(parts=((0,1),))], [None,{'status':'invalid'}])

# --- denial: capacity ----------------------------------------------------
h = run('deny_cap', [LB, P(env=((0,1),(1,10)), s=0, e=4)], [None, None])
h2 = fresh()
out = h2(json.loads(LB) if isinstance(LB,str) else LB)
# LB is a dict; redo with json string
LBs = json.dumps(LB)
h = fresh()
h(json.loads(LBs))
d = h(P(env=((0,1),(1,10)), s=0, e=4))
check('deny_capacity', d['status']=='denied' and d['kind']=='capacity' and d['link']==1 and d['used']==17 and d['capacity']==10, True)
check('deny_capacity_fields', set(d.keys()), {'status','id','rev','kind','link','time','used','capacity'})
# --- denial: cut ---------------------------------------------------------
h = fresh(); h(json.loads(LOADs:='{"op":"load","n":3,"links":[[0,1,1],[1,2,1]],"bookings":[]}'))
d = h(P(env=((0,3),(1,3)), parts=((0,5),(2,0))))
check('deny_cut', d['status']=='denied' and d['kind']=='cut', True)
Sset=set(d['cut']); parts={0,2}
inter=[v for v in d['cut'] if v in parts]
tot=sum(3 for lid,(u,v) in enumerate([(0,1),(1,2)]) if (u in Sset)!=(v in Sset))
check('deny_cut_valid', bool(inter) and len(inter)<2 and tot < sum({0:5,2:0}[v] for v in inter), True)

# --- commit / cancel -----------------------------------------------------
h = fresh(); h(json.loads(LOADs))
check('commit_missing', h({"op":"commit","id":"zz","owner":"o","rev":0}), {'status':'error','code':'MISSING','rev':0})
h(P())
check('commit_owner', h({"op":"commit","id":"j1","owner":"x","rev":0}), {'status':'error','code':'OWNER','rev':0})
check('commit_ok', h({"op":"commit","id":"j1","owner":"o","rev":0}), {'status':'ok','id':'j1','rev':1,'replay':False})
check('commit_replay', h({"op":"commit","id":"j1","owner":"o","rev":0}), {'status':'ok','id':'j1','rev':1,'replay':True})
check('audit_after_commit', h({"op":"audit","at":[0]}), {'status':'ok','rev':1,'now':0,'leases':['j1'],'samples':[[0,[9,9]]]})
check('cancel_stale', h({"op":"cancel","id":"j1","owner":"o","rev":0}), {'status':'stale','rev':1})
check('cancel_owner', h({"op":"cancel","id":"j1","owner":"x","rev":1}), {'status':'error','code':'OWNER','rev':1})
check('cancel_ok', h({"op":"cancel","id":"j1","owner":"o","rev":1}), {'status':'ok','rev':2,'released':'j1'})
check('cancel_again', h({"op":"cancel","id":"j1","owner":"o","rev":2}), {'status':'error','code':'MISSING','rev':2})
check('commit_gone', h({"op":"commit","id":"j1","owner":"o","rev":2}), {'status':'error','code':'GONE','rev':2})
check('prep_conflict_after_cancel', h(P(owner='q')), {'status':'error','code':'CONFLICT','rev':2})
check('prep_replay_after_cancel', h(P()), {'status':'replay','id':'j1','rev':2,'base_rev':0,'outcome':'prepared'})
# commit stale after revision moved on
h = fresh(); h(json.loads(LOADs)); h(P())
h({"op":"advance","time":0})
check('commit_stale', h({"op":"commit","id":"j1","owner":"o","rev":0}), {'status':'stale','rev':1})
check('commit_stale_rebase', h({"op":"commit","id":"j1","owner":"o","rev":1}), {'status':'stale','rev':1})
# denied id cannot be committed or cancelled
h = fresh(); h(json.loads(LOADs)); h(P(env=((0,3),(1,3)), parts=((0,5),(2,0))))
check('commit_denied', h({"op":"commit","id":"j1","owner":"o","rev":0}), {'status':'error','code':'DENIED','rev':0})
check('cancel_denied', h({"op":"cancel","id":"j1","owner":"o","rev":0}), {'status':'error','code':'MISSING','rev':0})
check('replay_denied', h(P(env=((0,3),(1,3)), parts=((0,5),(2,0)))), {'status':'replay','id':'j1','rev':0,'base_rev':0,'outcome':'denied'})
# prepare id colliding with a load booking id
h = fresh(); h(json.loads(LBs))
check('conflict_load_id', h(P(pid='b1')), {'status':'error','code':'CONFLICT','rev':0})
check('conflict_load_id_dead', (h({"op":"advance","time":9}), h(P(pid='b1')))[1], {'status':'error','code':'CONFLICT','rev':1})

print('fails', len(fails))
PYEOF
timeout 600 python3 -B tmp/svc_test2.py 2>&1 | tail -30
